a) a commitment, compulsory if possible, among virtuous countries to maximum emission thresholds;
b) a commitment to set up a minimum level of internal carbon tax;
c) an international market allowing for the exchange of national quotas between participating countries (on the Kyoto model);

d) managing the unpredictable reactions of fossil fuel markets (rapidly imposing high prices for carbon and ensuring their rise in the medium term so as to discourage rapid extraction and the irreversible increase of the greenhouse gas stock);
e) redistribution of the carbon tax toward nonvirtuous countries to help them favor the right technologies; and

f) a pedagogical effort to make public opinion understand the logic of this redistribution. There are also other elements important for the constitution of a carbon economy to be a successful case of economization: elaborating and implementing a good measuring system; rigorous surveillance devices in order to detect opportunistic behavior; the likely need to institute several carbon prices, depending on the industries involved; and national and international institutions whose mission is to set up these arrangements and ensure they function well and are sustainable.
人们提出了大量构型作为第三优。为说明这一点，让我们考虑一个程式化的模型，其中涉及四个利益分歧的行动者群体：产油国的垄断联盟；代表被视为有德（它们希望避免变暖）的消费国发言的计划者；对生态只有微弱承诺、专注于自身发展的无德消费国；最后是（尤其所谓有德国家中的）公众舆论，它以怀疑的眼光看待从富国向穷国的转移支付。
设想在这个力求尽可能贴近现实世界的世界里，有德国家决定征收碳税（此处的“税”是一个泛称，可以涵盖由市场决定的排放许可附加价格）。生产者垄断联盟可预见的反应，将是通过压低石油价格来补偿需求下降，而这会刺激无德国家增加消费。于是，在税制设立之初，大气中的碳存量会增加得比没有这种干预时更快。这个例子说明连锁反应可能多么复杂。对这些连锁反应的清点，导致人们提出应当结合以下要素的安排：
a）有德国家之间就最大排放阈值作出承诺，尽可能使之具有强制性；
b）承诺设立国内碳税的最低水平；
c）一个国际市场，允许参与国之间交换国家配额（按京都模式）；
d）管理化石燃料市场不可预测的反应（迅速对碳施加高价，并确保其在中期内上升，以抑制快速开采和温室气体存量的不可逆增长）；
e）把碳税收入向无德国家再分配，帮助它们支持合适的技术；
f）作出教育上的努力，使公众舆论理解这种再分配的逻辑。还有一些要素对于碳经济的构建成为经济化的成功案例也很重要：制定并实施良好的计量体系；为察觉机会主义行为而设置严格的监控装置；很可能需要依据所涉行业的不同而设立多种碳价格；以及承担设立这些安排、确保其良好运转并可持续的使命的国家机构与国际机构。

This simple list, which applies only for this very simple and highly stylized model, gives a sense of the complexity of the arrangements that correspond to third best. The complexity is such that it makes it very difficult to demonstrate, even qualitatively or in an indicative manner, that the proposed solutions would not trample the efficiency criterion. The more economic theory adopts the realistic economic policy approach, the more difficult it becomes to verify its normative aim. By dint of compromises, one ends up with propositions for which there is no evidence that they might bring true solutions. My pessimistic conclusion explains why some rather discouraged economists settle for invoking a fourth best as a last resort. Giving up on any idea of central coordination — in other words, a common house or a common world that would impose their moral and political requirements — they opt for a concoction of local initiatives still inspired by the vague and distant concern for effi -ciency, and they bet that the confluence of little streams generated in this way will gradually lead to a strong current in the right direction. Thus, they opt for the multiplication of local carbon markets wherever possible, either regional, national, or sectorial; communication between these different markets; creation of short-term financial markets managed as much as possible to avoid runaway speculation; border taxes; taxes at the source; pressure on producing countries; local and solidarity-based economies; and so on. Anything goes. And they pretend to believe, to reassure themselves, that this accumulation of measures will in the end converge in such a way as to produce acceptable results. We don’t have any apples, we don’t have any chocolate . . . let’s be satisfied with leftovers and make them sweet.

这份简单的清单只适用于这个极其简单、高度程式化的模型，它却让人感受到与第三优相对应的安排的复杂性。这种复杂性使得人们极难证明——哪怕是定性地或以指示性的方式——所提出的解决办法不会践踏效率标准。经济理论越是采用现实主义经济政策的进路，就越难以验证其规范性目标。由于一再妥协，人们最终得到的是一些无从证明其可能带来真正解决办法的主张。我的悲观结论解释了为什么一些相当沮丧的经济学家退而以呼唤第四优作为最后手段。他们放弃任何中心协调的观念——换言之，放弃一个会强加其道德与政治要求的共同之家或共同世界——转而选择由地方性倡议拼凑而成的大杂烩，这些倡议仍受一种模糊而遥远的效率关切的启发；他们赌的是，如此生成的小溪流汇聚起来，将逐渐形成朝向正确方向的强大水流。于是，他们选择在一切可能之处增殖地方碳市场，无论是区域的、国家的还是部门的；选择这些不同市场之间的沟通；创设短期金融市场，并尽可能加以管理以避免失控的投机；边境税；源头税；对生产国的施压；地方性的、以团结为基础的经济；等等。什么都行。而且他们假装相信——以安慰自己——这种措施的累积最终会汇聚起来，产生可接受的结果。我们没有苹果，我们也没有巧克力……那就满足于剩饭剩菜，并把它做甜吧。

This last approach is clearly an attractive way to keep sight of the planet’s fate, to show care for future generations, to be attentive to constraints and power relations without abandoning all hope of efficiency. It is also clear how hopeless it is. I do not mean to decry patching together a fourth best! Far from it. However, economization conceived of as a series of disclaimers makes this approach unconvincing and uninspiring. Yet from one global conference to another, governments and other players have ended up adopting this strategy, which inevitably leads in small steps toward a catastrophe we do not want to see, since we turn our backs on it, eyes riveted on an ideal world we are growing inexorably further from. The only remaining alternative is a choice between slow and gradual resignation, on the one hand, and a brutal and authoritarian global solution, on the other.

这最后一种进路显然是一种有吸引力的方式，使人得以继续关注地球的命运，关怀后代，注意约束与权力关系，同时又不放弃对效率的一切希望。同样清楚的是，它多么无望。我并不是要贬斥拼凑一个第四优！远非如此。然而，把经济化设想为一系列免责声明，使这一进路既缺乏说服力，也缺乏感召力。可是，从一次全球会议到另一次全球会议，各国政府及其他行动者最终采纳了这种策略；它不可避免地以小步走向一场我们不愿看见的灾难，因为我们背对着它，眼睛紧盯着一个我们正不可阻挡地远离的理想世界。剩下的唯一选择，一边是缓慢而渐进的认命，另一边是粗暴而威权的全球解决办法。

To escape this trap, I can see no other practical solution than to invert the direction of the process of economization. We should stop using a sole criterion — that of an optimum to be reached — to evaluate the actions to be undertaken, and we should certainly stop evaluating actions as a function of a unique value, whether it be called “efficiency,” “a fight against waste,” or “saving the planet and its inhabitants.” I see no other solution than to turn things around 180 degrees, to position ourselves no longer in relation to an unreachable good, but rather in relation to evil or evils that concern us, trouble us, worry us. In other words, we should start with matters of concern; we should consider their diversity and establish by trial and error which are likely to mitigate emissions of greenhouses gases. Instead of choosing the best possible situation as an attractor when one knows it cannot be realized, we should choose to fight off the worst situations, which will come about, for sure, if we do nothing.

为了逃出这一陷阱，我看不到别的实际办法，只能把经济化过程的方向颠倒过来。我们应当停止用唯一的标准——即有待达到的最优——来评价将要采取的行动；我们当然也应当停止根据某种唯一的价值来评价行动，无论这价值被称为“效率”、“与浪费作斗争”，还是“拯救地球及其居民”。我看不到别的办法，只能把事情翻转180度，使我们不再相对于一种不可企及的善来定位，而是相对于那些令我们关切、令我们不安、令我们忧虑的恶或诸恶来定位。换言之，我们应当从关切事项出发；我们应当考虑它们的多样性，并通过反复尝试来确定哪些关切有可能减少温室气体的排放。与其在明知最佳可能情境无法实现时把它选作吸引子，我们不如选择击退最坏的情境——如果我们什么都不做，这些情境必定会到来。

The general principle I am proposing gives a direction to the process of economization, but it does not determine any particular trajectory, mainly because the concerns linked directly to climate change are linked to other matters of concern that reinforce these matters of concern or on the contrary undermine them in the way elements of a network can oppose one another. Aggregations around common interests and coalitions are likely to take shape, adopting distinct causes, translating them into one another, and ensuring their convergence. Some, for instance, have long fought for energy transition, and not only because they were worried by climate change! There are countless forces in each particular time and place that could participate in forming alliances, even if climate change is not their main concern: those who design and produce solar panels or wind turbines; experts in home automation and insulation; automobile companies that promote electric vehicles; citizens fighting for more sober consumption; urban planners and architects who advocate for more compact cities and public transportation that guzzles less gas; political parties strategizing to keep their seats by fishing for ecological votes; citizens mobilized against the deterioration of their life conditions; financial experts in search of new products. This is where political strategy gets involved. If we, you and I, are worried about climate change, the only question to address to potential allies is the following: Does the cause you defend contribute or not to conserving fossil fuels?

我所提出的一般原则为经济化过程给出了一个方向，但它并不决定任何特定的轨迹，主要因为与气候变化直接相联系的关切，又与其他的关切事项相联系：后者或强化这些关切事项，或相反，像网络中的要素可以彼此对立那样削弱它们。围绕共同利益与联盟的聚集很可能成形，它们采纳不同的事业，把它们彼此转译，并确保其汇聚。例如，有些人长期以来为能源转型而斗争，而且并不仅仅是因为他们为气候变化而担忧！在每一个特定的时间与地点，都有无数力量可能参与结盟，即使气候变化并非它们的主要关切：设计并生产太阳能板或风力涡轮机的人；家居自动化与隔热方面的专家；推广电动汽车的汽车公司；为更节制的消费而斗争的公民；主张更紧凑的城市和油耗更低的公共交通的城市规划者与建筑师；盘算着捞取生态选票以保住议席的政党；为生活条件恶化而动员起来的公民；寻找新产品的金融专家。政治策略正是在这里介入。如果我们——你和我——为气候变化而担忧，那么向潜在盟友提出的唯一问题就是：你所捍卫的事业，是否有助于把化石燃料留在地下？

It used to be said that the markets could build the common good from individual selfishness, provided a few well-thought-out regulations were put in place. The proposition should be reversed. In order to ward off the common evil that you and I believe genuinely threatens us, would it not be simplest to work to coordinate actions that may indeed be diffuse, that indeed pursue different goods, but that added together push back the catastrophe you and I fear? Such a coalition can succeed only if it shows itself to be capable of weakening and paralyzing at the same time the forces that pull in the opposite direction. According to these, the real catastrophe is not brought about by wars, migrations, or the massive pauperization of entire populations, but by the disappearance of industries linked to the exploitation of fossil fuels or the arming of petrostates. They assert that without growth, unemployment would be ubiquitous and with unemployment, greater threats than climate change would appear. They hope and believe that traditional markets will find a way to solve the problems in the end and impose the necessary adjustments. There is therefore no possibility of an alternative modality of economization without doing the difficult work of sorting that is necessary to figure out one’s choice of allies and opponents.

人们过去常说，只要有若干深思熟虑的规制到位，市场就能从个体的自私中建造出共同善。这一命题应当被颠倒过来。为了挡开你我都相信确实威胁着我们的共同之恶，最简便的做法，难道不是努力去协调那些可能确实分散、确实追求不同的善、但加在一起却能击退你我所惧灾难的行动吗？这样一个联盟要取得成功，唯有表明它能够同时削弱并瘫痪那些朝相反方向拉扯的力量。按照后者的说法，真正的灾难并非由战争、迁徙或整个人口群体的大规模贫困化带来，而是由与化石燃料开采或向石油国家供应武器相关的产业的消失带来。他们断言，没有增长，失业将无处不在；而有了失业，就会出现比气候变化更大的威胁。他们希望并相信，传统市场最终会找到解决问题的办法，并强加必要的调整。因此，若不完成辨明敌友所必需的那项艰难的分类工作，就不可能有另一种经济化模式。

In the process of economization I’m presenting, which works the other way around from the one that currently predominates, we can engage with every initiative that we can, whatever the motivations and aims, that contributes to leaving carbon underground and to minimizing atmospheric emissions. These initiatives may come in the form of devices that profile
homo economicus

, calculating their decisions on the basis of their own interests, but with appropriate evaluation and accounting instruments (fiscal incentives, indices linked to share portfolios that contribute to decarbonizing industrial activities, internalization of externalities) and with new objects (green obligations for renewable energies).

They may also be binding laws or regulations making certain behavior compulsory and punishing violations severely. Those who wish to go further should imagine devices that favor altruistic and solidarity-based behavior, the localization of economic behavior known as short-circuiting,

sober consumption, and moral reflection on the future of our planet. And let us not forget what a huge effort in research and development, experimentation and investigation, is required in order to bring out new resources, new processes, and new products. Furthermore, what would this alliance be if it did not tackle, head on at the same time, the questions of worldwide inequalities, poverty, and the wars that are tearing our planet apart? Consider countries such as Sweden, where, at the time of writing, a tax of 117 euros is levied on each ton of carbon dioxide emitted into the atmosphere, where the regressive redistribution effects of environmental taxes have been compensated for by appropriate fiscal reform (because by taxing everyone, one sometimes penalizes the poorest), where clean technologies are developed, and where the aim to “leave for the next generation a society in which the main environmental problems will have been solved” has been written into the constitution. Such countries show that political engineering of market agencements is viable. Others are following, such as some Canadian provinces, Chile, and perhaps China, which uses climate policy as a means of government. Nonetheless, from one country to another, the configurations of the agencements will differ, and there is no reason to believe that framings will eventually be homogenized.
在我所呈现的这一经济化过程中——它与当前占主导地位的过程方向相反——我们可以接纳一切能够接纳的倡议，无论其动机与目标如何，只要它们有助于把碳留在地下、有助于使大气排放最小化。这些倡议可以采取这样的装置形式：它们塑造经济人（
homo economicus
），使其依据自身利益计算决策，但配有适当的评价与核算工具（财政激励、与股票组合相联系以推动工业活动脱碳的指数、外部性的内化），并配有新的物品（用于可再生能源的绿色债券）。
它们也可以是有约束力的法律或规制，强制某些行为并严厉惩罚违规。希望走得更远的人，应当设想有利于利他行为与团结行为、有利于被称为短链化（short-circuiting）的经济行为本地化、

有利于节制消费、有利于对我们星球未来作道德反思的装置。我们也不要忘记，为了开发新资源、新工艺和新产品，需要在研究与开发、实验与调查上付出多么巨大的努力。此外，如果这一联盟不同时正面处理全球不平等、贫困以及撕裂我们星球的战争等问题，它还成其为联盟吗？试看瑞典这样的国家：在写作本书之时，那里对排入大气的每一吨二氧化碳征收117欧元的税；环境税累退性的再分配效应已通过适当的税制改革得到补偿（因为向所有人征税，有时会惩罚最贫穷者）；清洁技术在那里得到开发；“为下一代留下一个主要环境问题均已得到解决的社会”这一目标已被写入宪法。这样的国家表明，市场装配的政治工程学是可行的。其他国家正在跟进，例如加拿大的某些省份、智利，或许还有把气候政策用作治理手段的中国。然而，从一个国家到另一个国家，装配的构型将会不同，也没有理由相信各种框定最终会趋于同质化。

The social sciences may contribute, at least partly and in different ways, to this theorization. For example, there is work to be done in order to identify the forces, spread out and disseminated, that are moving in the right direction — that is, moving away from the evils to be avoided — although often without realizing they are doing so. The conception of acceptable criteria to appreciate the results obtained is another potential area of contribution. Economic theory — that is, a reconfigured economic theory — could also offer a powerful contribution to this evaluation by identifying the unexpected effects, by participating in the conception of new accounting instruments, by redefining efficiency in such a way as to take into account the innovation processes without which the worst will remain certain.

This is why economic theory and the economy could reinvent themselves at the same time on the basis of what exists today if they started from the numerous mobilizations that concerted political action can make converge. With some tinkering, recombining, local experimentation, and partial coordinations, we could move away from the worst of configurations, what we might agree to call the
n
th worst, to go to
n
- 1 worst, then the
n

- 2 worst. At each step, the economization proceeds, building on a political and material infrastructure that ensures solidity and stability. The more we ascend a steep path to get away from the worst situations, the more we contribute to finding satisfying solutions. In the modern scenario, we face a descent into hell that we are trying to fight or delay. In my approach, we face an ascent as we discover the good by getting further away from the evil that we see and want to flee.

社会科学可以至少部分地、以不同方式为这一理论化作出贡献。例如，有待做的工作是识别那些分散而弥散的、正朝正确方向——即远离应予避免的诸恶——运动的力量，尽管它们往往并未意识到自己正在这样做。构想用以评价所获结果的可接受标准，是另一个可能的贡献领域。经济理论——也就是一种重新配置的经济理论——也可以为这种评价作出有力贡献：识别意外效应，参与新核算工具的构想，重新界定效率，从而把创新过程纳入考虑，因为若没有这些创新过程，最坏者将始终确定无疑。
正因如此，如果经济理论与经济以当今存在的东西为起点，从协同政治行动所能汇聚的众多动员出发，它们就可能同时实现自我再造。通过一些修补、重组、地方实验和局部协调，我们可以离开最坏的构型——我们不妨称之为第
n
坏——走向第
n
−1 坏，然后是第
n
−2 坏。每走一步，经济化都在推进，依托于确保坚固与稳定的政治与物质基础设施。我们越是沿着陡峭的道路攀升以离开最坏的情境，就越是有助于找到令人满意的解决办法。在现代的情景中，我们面对的是向地狱的坠落，我们试图抗击或延缓它。在我的进路中，我们面对的是上升：我们通过远离我们所看见并想要逃离的恶，来发现善。

Over the course of this step-by-step progressive inquiry, with the dose of Machiavellianism it implies, new framings will take shape, allowing the cycle of political engineering to move forward. It is clear that the goods on offer will no longer be the same, since they will have internalized, in their very qualification, the concerns linked directly or indirectly to global warming. We will no longer consume the same thing or in the same way. It is clear that the qualculation tools, and notably the accounting tools, will have changed. For instance, depending on whether they are counted as assets or provisions, including emission quotas in company accounting will produce very different impacts on their results and hence on the orientation of industrial strategies. It is clear that the modes of organizing meetings between the different agencies involved will have profoundly evolved, including not only the classical institutions such as the UN, the IPCC (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change), or the stakeholder conferences, with their rules and adjustment mechanisms, but also sites of metrological normalization, where the instruments of measure for emissions and their effects will be negotiated; there are also different auction devices. It is clear that the forms of
affectio mercatus

and the attachment devices will have been profoundly transformed with the rise of local solidarity markets. Finally, to crown the lot, price formulation will have been disrupted, taxes or new prosthetic prices will be included, such as those attributed to carbon in the markets for emission rights. Starting from the concerns, from their shaping and expression, one inevitably ends up linking together problems that disciplinary work has contributed to separating. In this conversation, we are reconnecting the relationship between production and consumption.

在这一步步推进的探究过程中，伴随着它所意味的那一份马基雅维利主义，新的框定将会成形，使政治工程学的循环得以向前推进。显然，所提供的物品将不再是同样的，因为它们将在其品质界定本身之中，把与全球变暖直接或间接相联系的关切内化。我们将不再消费同样的东西，也不再以同样的方式消费。显然，质算工具、尤其是核算工具将会改变。例如，排放配额在公司会计中被计为资产还是准备金，将对其结果、从而对工业战略的取向产生极为不同的影响。显然，所涉不同能动者之间相遇的组织方式将发生深刻演变，不仅包括联合国、政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）或利益相关方会议这类经典机构及其规则与调整机制，还包括计量学标准化的场所——排放及其影响的测量工具将在那里被协商；此外还有各种拍卖装置。显然，随着地方团结市场的兴起，市场情动（
affectio mercatus
）的形式与附着装置将发生深刻转变。最后，作为压轴，价格构式将被打乱，税收或新的义肢性价格将被纳入其中，例如在排放权市场上赋予碳的那些价格。从关切出发，从关切的塑形与表达出发，人们不可避免地会把学科工作曾有助于分开的问题重新联结起来。在这场对话中，我们重新连接了生产与消费之间的关系。

The resulting agencements cannot be described a priori since the details will be found in the process of moving forward: market organization means permanently conflictual invention! Here, I want only to underline that what is at stake in theorization, in the negotiations and power plays it implies, is the reconfiguration of framings that will play out over multiple sites and mobilize numerous different agencies. The notion of agencement makes it possible to think and describe this diversity, to verify that the addition of these little forces can lead to a united movement in the intended direction. Everything could help. Those who want to participate in this program to reduce carbon release into the atmosphere should not neglect anything.
Faire l’économie du pire

in both senses of the French expression: to minimize the worst, but also to organize this avoidance as robustly and efficiently as possible. In this movement, politics, morality, and economics are not like tectonic plates that drift and collide, creating hot spots where they make contact, provoking earthquakes and eruptions that disappear before surfacing elsewhere. Rather, political expressions, commercial transactions, and moral concerns are everywhere in agencements: in each framing, in each strategy for alignment or articulation. Borders are constantly redrawn locally. And if the work of theorization is so important and necessary, it is because as in the war games of military training, it makes it possible to provide at any moment a representation of the state of existing forces, current movements, and emerging trends, in turn making it possible to answer the simple question at the heart of action: What next?

由此产生的装配无法先验地描述，因为细节将在前进的过程中被发现：市场组织意味着永久的冲突性发明！在这里，我只想强调：理论化——连同它所意味的谈判与权力博弈——的利害所在，是框定的重新配置，而这一配置将在多个场所展开，并调动众多不同的能动者。装配这一概念使人能够思考和描述这种多样性，能够验证这些小力量的相加能否在预期方向上汇成统一的运动。一切都可能有帮助。那些希望参与这一减少碳向大气释放的纲领的人，不应忽略任何东西。
Faire l’économie du pire

，按这一法语表达的双重含义：既是最小化最坏者，也是尽可能稳健而高效地组织这种避免。在这一运动中，政治、道德与经济学并不像构造板块那样漂移、碰撞，在接触处形成热点，引发地震与喷发，而后者又在别处浮现之前消失。相反，政治表达、商业交易与道德关切无处不在，存在于装配之中：在每一个框定中，在每一种对齐或接合的策略中。边界不断在地方层面被重新划定。而理论化工作之所以如此重要和必要，是因为它如同军事训练中的兵棋推演，使人能够在任何时刻提供一幅现有力量状态、当前运动与新兴趋势的图景，从而使人能够回答行动核心处的那个简单问题：接下来做什么？

No successful instance of reasoned political engineering that is oriented explicitly and willfully toward aims that certain agencies cherish and seek to reach (in this case, limiting climate change) can avoid playing the game of contending with existing forces. Although such a strategy could sometimes succeed (everything depends on circumstances), it would be vain to seek a political or moral agreement first (the earth is in danger, it should be saved, and with it, future generations) and only afterward deduce the commercial configurations best suited to this agreement. Theorization requires humility. It requires refusing moral or political grandiloquence. To attract attention, increase public awareness, and organize possible convergences, it may be appropriate to say that the planet is in peril or that our shared home is on fire. The warnings are of little use, however, in the design of market agencements. “Good” configurations can be found only by climbing up the slope: they are found by trial and error, a bit by chance. They appear to us “almost unnoticed, like a mist seeping gently beneath a closed door,”

on condition that we never lose sight of the only goal that unites us — namely, pulling away from the worst, with the support of all the forces that can facilitate this movement if the proper agencements are found. We could speak, by antithesis, of taking a distance from the
pessimum
, rather than searching for the
optimum
! There is no single configuration because there is no agreement on concerns and their articulation. Let us resign ourselves to admitting that there
can
be no agreement.

任何有理据的政治工程学，若明确而自觉地朝向某些能动者所珍视并力求达到的目标（在此即限制气候变化），都不可能回避与现有力量较量的游戏。尽管这样的策略有时可能成功（一切取决于境况），但若先寻求一种政治或道德上的共识（地球处于危险之中，应当拯救它，并连同拯救后代），然后再从中推演出最适合这一共识的商业构型，那将是徒劳的。理论化需要谦卑。它要求拒绝道德或政治上的豪言壮语。为了吸引注意、提高公众意识、组织可能的汇聚，说这个星球岌岌可危，或者说我们共同的家园正在燃烧，或许是恰当的。然而，这些警告对于市场装配的设计用处不大。只有沿着斜坡向上攀登，才能找到“好的”构型：它们是通过反复尝试、几分靠偶然找到的。它们“几乎不被察觉地，像雾从紧闭的门下悄悄渗入”向我们显现，
条件是我们永不忘记那个唯一把我们联合起来的目标——即远离最坏者，并借助一切只要找到恰当装配便能推动这一运动的力量。我们可以反义地说：与
最劣
保持距离，而不是寻找
最优
！不存在单一的构型，因为对于关切及其接合并不存在共识。那就让我们承认：
可能
无法达成全面共识。
HOW MARKET AGENCEMENTS COEXIST: THE CASE OF GENETICALLY MODIFIED CROPS
市场装配如何共存：转基因作物案例

If we think carefully about the cycle of political engineering of market agencements, we will be led to abandon the regulative idea of efficiency. This also invites us to attend to concerns — that is to say, to the formulation of new objectives for agencements. These are our first insights into the relations between economics and politics in markets. Once objectives have been expressed and their multiplicity and divergences observed, the perspective I have put forward opens onto the following question: What are the practical provisions that must be imagined in order to design agencements and their articulation with moral and political action?
如果我们仔细思考市场装配之政治工程的周期，我们就会被引向放弃效率这一调节性理念。这也邀请我们去关注关切事项——也就是说，去关注为装配构想新目标的工作。这些是我们关于市场中经济与政治之关系的最初洞见。一旦目标得到表达，其多重性与分歧得到观察，我所提出的视角便敞开为如下问题：为了设计装配，并设计装配与道德行动和政治行动的接合，必须设想哪些实践性安排？

Practical provisions, however, are not enough to carry the day. Sometimes —rather often, in fact — the divergences are such, the concerns are so contradictory, that the work of theorizing, even if it seeks to be humble and modest, fails to conceive of agencements that could hold these opposing forces together and align alternative framings. In such situations, states often turn out to be the central actors that, in the name of what they define as the common good, take on the mission of finding and ensuring modes of lasting coexistence for the different agencies. For this, recourse to theory is useful — indeed, indispensable. When the objectives being defended are irreconcilable and the power relations are such that no one will compromise, the question becomes how the different market agencements in competition with one another can be made to cohabit durably. This is the situation I want now to present in outline, to show how the political engineering of market agencements leads to the task of theorizing novel ambitions and objects. The recent history of agriculture and agribusiness and the place of genetically modified crops (GMCs) provides a striking illustration.

然而，仅有实践性安排并不足以成事。有时——事实上相当常见——分歧如此之大，关切事项如此相互矛盾，以至于理论化工作即便力求谦逊节制，也无法构想出能够把这些对立力量维系在一起、并使彼此替代的诸框定相互对齐的装配。在此类情境中，国家往往成为核心行动者：它以自己所界定的共同善之名，承担起为不同能动者寻找并确保持久共存方式的使命。为此，求诸理论是有用的——甚至是不可或缺的。当所捍卫的目标不可调和、力量关系又使无人愿意妥协时，问题就变成：如何使彼此竞争的不同市场装配持久地共处。这正是我现在想扼要呈现的情境，以表明市场装配的政治工程如何导向一项任务，即对新的抱负与新的对象进行理论化。农业与农业综合企业（agribusiness）的晚近历史，以及转基因作物（genetically modified crops，GMCs）在其中的位置，提供了一个引人注目的例证。

At first, at least in certain European countries, there were serious health and environmental concerns when GMCs were introduced. How could one be sure that these plants, which escape what is considered natural regulation, would not provoke deleterious effects on human health in the long run or, more generally, would not threaten the equilibrium of ecosystems? Such were the worries and concerns that prevailed at first. They led several states to forbid the use of GMCs. However, beyond these classical problems, other questions and issues quickly appeared, problems of a quite different nature. Behind the decision regarding GMCs, some saw a more profound choice between two ways of organizing and practicing agriculture, two ways of structuring agribusiness. On the one hand, there is an agriculture that considers itself respectful of natural cycles and that, when it uses techniques of crossbreeding and selection, is content to organize natural processes by intensifying and orienting them. This agriculture is committed to valorizing farmers’ autonomy and skills and to supporting their mastery over the way their agricultural holdings are managed. On the other hand, there is an agriculture that relies on the massive use of invasive technologies, aiming to modify plants’ genomes artificially in order to obtain plant species that can withstand drought, pesticides, or herbicides or that can produce medical treatments or improve nutritional content, and so on. Here, the farmer’s role is to implement techniques that are defined from the outside. These forms of agriculture and agribusiness are organized in order to respond to such radically different preoccupations that they appear to the protagonists to be mutually incompatible. The main reason for this incompatibility — there are, of course, others — is linked to diverging conceptions of how to orient and organize research. In the first case, research gives priority to outdoor experimentation in field research stations. Its main operating mode is crossbreeding selections in open surroundings. This research, which more and more often calls on sophisticated techniques and advanced knowledge, depends on a close collaboration between farmers and scientists. It requires a form of industrial property (in France, the Certificat d’Obtention Végétale, COV, the certificate of plant variety protection) that favors its type of innovation. It leads to food products that are qualified as natural and presented as respecting ecological equilibrium, and it stimulates establishing what are called short distribution channels. In the second case, most of the research is in laboratories, mostly private, some public, and is confined to scientists. It is characterized by the near total absence of farmers, whose role is essentially to make use of seeds and techniques that are defined without them. This research requires massive investments that are controlled by powerful multinational companies. It relies on an intense collaboration between companies and academic circles. It protects its results through a vigorous intellectual property policy that ensures a de facto monopoly for a handful of seed producers acting globally, such as Monsanto or Syngenta. In this configuration, farmers’ skills are radically transformed, and the end consumers are supposed to be interested only in prices and the functional qualities of the goods, without a thought for natural equilibria, social responsibility, or the living conditions of farmers.

起初，至少在某些欧洲国家，转基因作物被引入时引发了严重的健康与环境关切。人们怎能确信，这些逃脱了被视为自然调节的植物，从长远看不会对人类健康造成有害影响，或者更一般地说，不会威胁生态系统的平衡？这就是最初占据主导的忧虑与关切。它们促使若干国家禁止使用转基因作物。然而，在这些经典问题之外，其他问题与议题很快出现，其性质颇为不同。在关于转基因作物的决定背后，一些人看到了一个更为深刻的选择，即在两种组织与实践农业的方式之间、在两种建构农业综合企业的方式之间的选择。一方面，是一种自认为尊重自然循环的农业；当它使用杂交与选育技术时，满足于通过强化并引导自然过程来组织这些过程。这种农业致力于彰显农民的自主性与技能，并支持他们掌控自己农业经营体的管理方式。另一方面，是一种依赖大规模使用侵入性技术的农业，它旨在人为地改造植物基因组，以获得能够耐旱、耐受农药或除草剂，或能够产生医疗物质、改善营养成分等等的植物品种。在这里，农民的角色是实施那些由外部界定的技术。这些农业与农业综合企业形式被组织起来，以回应如此截然不同的关注，以至于在相关行动者看来，它们彼此不可兼容。这种不可兼容的主要原因——当然还有其他原因——与如何引导和组织研究的分歧性观念有关。在第一种情况下，研究优先考虑田间研究站中的户外实验。其主要运作模式是在开放环境中进行杂交选育。这种研究越来越多地借助精密技术与先进知识，依赖农民与科学家之间的紧密合作。它需要一种有利于其创新类型的工业产权形式（在法国，即植物新品种保护证书［Certificat d’Obtention Végétale，COV］）。它产生被界定为天然的、并被呈现为尊重生态平衡的食品，并促进所谓短流通渠道的建立。在第二种情况下，大部分研究在实验室中进行，多为私人实验室，也有一些公共实验室，且仅限于科学家参与。其特征是农民几乎完全缺席，农民的角色本质上只是使用那些在没有他们参与的情况下被界定的种子与技术。这种研究需要巨额投资，而这些投资由强大的跨国公司掌控。它依赖公司与学术界之间的密切合作。它通过强硬的知识产权政策保护其成果，这种政策为少数在全球范围行动的种子生产者——例如孟山都（Monsanto）或先正达（Syngenta）——确保了事实上的垄断。在这种配置中，农民的技能被彻底转化，而最终消费者则被假定只关心物品的价格与功能品质，不会考虑自然平衡、社会责任或农民的生活条件。
These two ways of organizing economic activities (let us call them MA1 and MA2)

are totally incompatible, or at least that is how the proponents of what can be summarily described as “natural agriculture” see things. Granted, this black-and-white depiction of the situation is simplistic. By seeking compromise, intermediary strategies are developed. For instance, searching for a form of industrial intellectual property that while protecting laboratory research and the recourse to expensive cutting-edge technologies also preserves farmers’ autonomy and margins of maneuver, guaranteeing that consumers would be offered a choice. As techniques evolve to organize a transition from pure transgenesis toward forms of assisted genetic selection, the search for a middle road may become easier. For the moment, however, there is a fierce confrontation between two models that consider themselves all the more impossible to reconcile because recent judicial rulings have increased multinational companies’ grip on seed production by extending patentability to plant species themselves. (See Chapter 2.) In Europe, where for historical reasons this clash is particularly violent, the idea has taken hold that the only possible solution is not to let market forces and technique arbitrate between these two fundamentally opposing worlds, but instead to organize their coexistence. It is no longer a matter, as in preceding examples, of designing and implementing agencements that take well-identified concerns into account, but of conceiving of a kind political engineering we might call “conservatory” that provides safeguards so as to ensure that both forms of agencements, with their specific policies, are sustainable. This is a way of refusing to arbitrate between them, at least for a while. It is as though in the case of global warming one compromised between two modalities of economy, one in which greenhouse gases were ousted, the other in which they were tolerated. The comparison is not irrelevant: those who decry genetic agriculture assert that genetic dissemination is inevitable and threatens the entire planet.
这两种组织经济活动的方式（我们不妨称之为 MA1 与 MA2）

完全不可兼容，至少那些可以被简要描述为“自然农业”的倡导者是这么看的。诚然，这种非黑即白的描绘过于简单化。通过寻求妥协，人们发展出一些中间策略。例如，寻找一种工业知识产权形式，它既保护实验室研究以及对昂贵尖端技术的使用，又保全农民的自主性与回旋余地，并保证消费者仍能有所选择。随着技术演进到足以组织从纯转基因向各种辅助性遗传选择形式的过渡，寻找中间道路或许会变得更容易。然而，目前两个模式之间仍存在激烈对抗，而它们之所以认为自己愈发无法调和，是因为近来的司法裁决把可专利性扩展至植物物种本身，从而加强了跨国公司对种子生产的控制。（参见第二章。）在欧洲，由于历史原因，这种冲突尤为激烈，人们已形成这样一种看法：唯一可能的解决办法，不是让市场力量与技术在这两个根本对立的世界之间作出仲裁，而是组织它们的共存。这里不再像前面的例子那样，涉及设计并实施把明确界定的关切事项纳入考虑的装配，而是涉及构想一种我们可以称为“保存式”的政治工程；它提供保障措施，以确保两种装配形式连同其各自特有的政策都能够持续存在。这是一种拒绝在二者之间作出仲裁的方式，至少在一段时间内如此。这就好像在全球变暖的情形中，人们在两种经济模态之间达成妥协：一种把温室气体驱逐出去，另一种则容忍温室气体。这一比较并非无关紧要：谴责基因农业的人断言，基因传播不可避免，并威胁整个星球。

It is as though secularism had migrated from the religious sphere to the economic sphere. Coexistence has become a legal obligation, both in European law and in its national transcriptions. Article 2 of the French law on GMOs of June 25, 2008, stipulates that “genetically organized organisms cannot be cultivated, commercialized, or used except in ways that respect the environment and public health, agricultural structures, local ecosystems, and the commercial sectors ‘without genetically modified organisms,’ and this with full transparency.” It adds that “freedom to consume and produce with or without genetically modified organisms without harming the integrity of the environment and the specificity of traditional quality cultures is guaranteed respecting the precautionary principle, principles of prevention, information,
participation
and
responsibility
, inscribed in the Environmental Charter of 2004 and respecting European provisions” (my emphasis).

仿佛世俗主义已经从宗教领域迁移到了经济领域。共存已成为一项法律义务，无论是在欧洲法中，还是在其各国国内法的转化文本中。2008年6月25日法国关于转基因生物的法律第2条规定：“转基因生物不得被种植、商业化或使用，除非以尊重环境与公共卫生、农业结构、地方生态系统以及‘不含转基因生物’的生产及商业链的方式进行，且须完全透明。”该条还补充说：“在有或没有转基因生物的情况下消费和生产的自由，在不损害环境完整性以及传统作物栽培及优质作物栽培的特殊性的前提下，得到保障；此种自由应遵守2004年《环境宪章》（Environmental Charter）所载的风险预防原则（precaution）、预防原则（prevention）、信息原则、
参与
原则与
责任
原则，并遵守欧洲的各项规定”（着重为作者所加）。

The technical engineering of markets, as it exists today, cannot fulfill such a set of requirements. The markets, by construction and whatever regulations are imagined, can do nothing about the way science is organized other than indirectly and therefore in a superficial and limited way, beyond the very crude and unrealistic and therefore unrealizable principles of separation of open academic research and closed private technological research.

Furthermore, they are quite incapable of fulfilling the requirements for participation and consultation specified by the law or of making room for the protection and development of certain forms of traditional activities and the territorial structurings these activities require. Although it should not disappear from our radars altogether, the notion of efficiency is even more difficult to mobilize than in the case of financial markets or global warming. In any case, no regulation would be strong enough to contain such powerfully antagonistic forces. Thus, what is at stake is a way to conceive of agencements that through the framings they impose and the configurations they favor ensure that both forms of commercial activity continue to be viable.
今天存在的市场技术工程，无法满足这样一整套要求。就其构造而言，无论设想何种规制，市场对科学被组织的方式都只能间接地、因而肤浅而有限地发挥作用；除此之外，便只有那些极为粗糙、不切实际因而无法实现的分离原则，即把开放的学术研究与封闭的私人技术研究分离开来。
此外，市场完全无力满足法律所规定的参与与协商要求，也无力为保护和发展某些形式的传统活动以及这些活动所需的地域组织安排留出空间。效率这一概念虽然不应完全从我们的雷达上消失，但它比在金融市场或全球变暖的情形中更难以调动。无论如何，没有任何规制会强大到足以遏制如此强有力的对抗性力量。因此，关键在于构想出这样一些装配：它们通过所强加的诸框定和所促成的配置，确保两种商业活动形式都继续具有存续能力。

Let there be a commercial configuration, MA1 or MA2. Under what conditions can it exist in a sustainable way or even grow without threatening the existence of other agencements that are considered to be equally legitimate and as having to be preserved at all costs? It is the task of theorization to answer that question. As in the previous cases (financial markets and climate change), in order to identify possible answers, the simplest strategy is to start from the (rare) available theories that have studied the mechanisms through which certain commercial configurations eliminate others. They center on a notion that we have already encountered: sociotechnical lock-in.

假定存在一种商业配置，MA1 或 MA2。它在什么条件下能够以可持续的方式存在，甚至增长，而又不威胁其他装配的存在——那些装配被认为同样正当，并被认为必须不惜一切代价加以保存？回答这个问题是理论化的任务。如同前面的案例（金融市场与气候变化），为了找出可能的答案，最简单的策略是从那些研究某些商业配置借以消灭其他配置之机制的（为数不多的）现有理论出发。这些理论围绕一个我们已经遇到过的概念展开：社会技术锁定（sociotechnical lock-in）。

According to theories of sociotechnical lock-in, markets lock themselves into models of functioning that end up limiting the choices available to agents. Three factors explain this movement. The first depends directly on the balance of power and the political dealings that extend from it. Certain agents — I’m thinking of the electronuclear sector in France in the 1970s and 1980s — can disqualify and eliminate sufficiently effectively and for sufficiently long the options that go against their interests or preferences. The effects linked to the accumulation of skills, knowledge, and know-how increasingly supplement the direct actions of these coalitions. When an option has access to research and mobilizes the scientific and technical milieu more and more exclusively, it ends up with a relative advantage that gives it a strong position in economic competition: the technologies and skills in which there has been heavy investment rapidly become more efficient than those that have been deserted, even if the latter, with investments of the same magnitude, might have been comparable. Evolutionary economists sum up this mechanism in a striking way when they say that a technology does not necessarily take over because it is the best, but rather that it is the best because it has taken over. This advantage grows over time, notably if it is shored up with solid property rights. Finally, complementarities between techniques, skills, and activities establish themselves, further increasing irreversibility and lock-ins. For example, Monsanto, which is perfecting transgenic corn that is glyphosate resistant and which at the same time offers glyphosate (Roundup) to farmers to eradicate weeds, ends up becoming inescapable. All in all, a world takes shape that leaves little room and little chance for alternative worlds. Sociotechnical lock-ins nip any project for the coexistence of different market agencements in the bud.

根据社会技术锁定理论，市场会把自身锁定于某些运作模式，而这些模式最终限制了行动者可用的选择。有三个因素解释了这一运动。第一个因素直接取决于力量平衡以及由之延伸出的政治交易。某些行动者——我想到的是1970年代与1980年代法国的核电部门——能够足够有效且足够长久地取消并排除那些违背其利益或偏好的选项。与技能、知识和诀窍之积累相联系的效果，日益补充这些联盟的直接行动。当某一选项能够接触研究，并越来越排他地调动科学与技术界时，它最终会获得一种相对优势，从而在经济竞争中占据强势地位：那些已获大量投资的技术与技能，会迅速变得比被弃置的技术与技能更有效率，即便后者若获得同等规模的投资，本可能与之相当。演化经济学家以一种引人注目的方式概括了这一机制：一种技术之所以胜出，并不必然因为它是最好的，毋宁说，它之所以是最好的，是因为它已经胜出。这种优势随时间而增长，尤其是当它得到稳固的财产权支撑时。最后，技术、技能与活动之间的互补性得以确立，进一步增加了不可逆性与锁定。例如，孟山都在完善抗草甘膦的转基因玉米，同时又向农民提供草甘膦（农达［Roundup］）以清除杂草，最终变得令人无法回避。总而言之，一个世界逐渐成形，它留给替代性世界的空间与机会都很少。社会技术锁定把任何关于不同市场装配共存的项目扼杀于萌芽之中。

The problem is to imagine mechanisms that might prevent such lock-ins. For instance, in the case we are concerned with, the conflict between MA1 and MA2, what type of market agencements would have to be designed in order to respond to the legal injunctions and ensure the durable coexistence of genetic agriculture and natural agriculture? One can sense that if nothing were done, the dominant dynamic described by theories of sociotechnical lock-ins would lead to the gradual exclusion of MA1, which would be reduced to niche activities, to MA2’s benefit. The balance of power between the two agencements and the nearly total exclusion it would eventually lead to derive essentially from the capacity that the firms that chose to implement MA2 have to mobilize immense technological resources. MA2 would gain control of the market without encountering any resistance because it would, early on, have had scientific and technical power vastly superior to that on which MA1 could rely.

问题在于设想可能阻止此类锁定的机制。例如，在我们所关心的案例中，即 MA1 与 MA2 之间的冲突，必须设计何种类型的市场装配，才能满足法律要求，并确保基因农业与自然农业的持久共存？人们可以感觉到，如果无所作为，社会技术锁定理论所描述的那种主导性动态将导致 MA1 逐渐被排除，使其被化约为利基活动，从而有利于 MA2。两种装配之间的力量平衡，以及这种平衡最终将导致的近乎完全的排斥，本质上源自选择实施 MA2 的企业所具备的调动巨量技术资源的能力。MA2 将掌控市场而遇不到任何抵抗，因为它在早期就拥有远胜于 MA1 所能依赖的科学与技术力量。

In the medium term, however, MA2’s victory is not yet a foregone conclusion, insofar as in some countries, and notably in the EU, resistance has organized. The resistance is essentially political around certain states aiming to mitigate MA2’s dominance. In countries such as France, Austria, Germany, and the UK, the relations between MA1 and MA2 in agriculture have been structured by a distribution of strongholds upstream and downstream of the industrial sector. The actors of MA1 have only very limited access to research and development, whereas those of MA2 (mostly non-French) can mobilize considerable scientific and technical resources and consequently master the upstream of this economic sector. This is the case, first because historically, some of the most powerful companies come from the chemical sector, where they already had scientific and technical firepower, but also because this situation of asymmetry has been reinforced over the years. However, the balance of power is shifting. Meanwhile, the agencies of MA1 have not been inactive. They have skillfully established their downstream domination, alternating between intimidation practices, legal action, and political lobbying, leading political deciders to forbid GMOs and persuading consumers to take part in the fight. The institutional lock-in, as it takes shape downstream, leans in favor of MA1. The confrontation between these two movements is resolved in a sort of Yalta between upstream and downstream. It is, however, a fragile Yalta. However strong they are, the (political and ethical) institutional lock-ins are not as efficient or durable as those anchored in knowledge and know-how and in the rules and social networks of industrial property rights.

然而，从中期看，MA2 的胜利尚未成为定局，因为在一些国家、尤其是在欧盟（EU），抵抗已经组织起来。这种抵抗本质上是政治性的，围绕某些试图减轻 MA2 支配地位的国家展开。在法国、奥地利、德国和英国等国家，农业中 MA1 与 MA2 的关系由工业部门上下游之间的据点分配所结构化。MA1 的行动者对研究与开发的接触机会非常有限，而 MA2 的行动者（大多不是法国企业）则能够调动可观的科学与技术资源，从而掌控该经济部门的上游。之所以如此，首先是因为从历史上看，一些最强大的公司来自化学部门，在那里它们早已拥有科学与技术火力；其次是因为这种不对称状况多年来不断得到强化。然而，力量平衡正在发生变化。与此同时，MA1 的能动者也并非无所作为。它们巧妙地确立了自己的下游支配地位，在恐吓做法、法律诉讼与政治游说之间交替，促使政治决策者禁止转基因生物，并说服消费者参与这场斗争。随着制度性锁定在下游成形，它倾向于有利于 MA1。这两种运动之间的对抗，在上游与下游之间以某种雅尔塔（Yalta）式安排得到解决。然而，这是一个脆弱的雅尔塔。无论（政治与伦理的）制度性锁定多么强大，它们都不如那些锚定于知识与诀窍、锚定于工业产权规则与社会网络之中的锁定那样有效或持久。

The question is therefore how to get out of this fragile and paralyzing equilibrium toward a coexistence that, to be durable, must be established both in the sector of scientific and technological research and in the sector of production and commercialization. (How can what is downstream do without what’s upstream, or vice versa?) The theoretical answer is obvious: MA1 must be given broad access to technological resources, notably by facilitating cooperation with public research in field experimentation, and the regime of intellectual property rights must be transformed in such a way as to bring it closer to the one the COV inaugurated. Then, and symmetrically, MA2 must be given access to farmers’ fields, but in such a way that the territorial distribution between different types of agriculture is strictly organized and controlled, notably by implementing devices for consultation, (environmental and health) monitoring and tracking, and ensuring larger-scale geographical segmentation, which favors reasoned mingling of different crop types.

因此，问题在于如何走出这种脆弱而令人瘫痪的均衡，走向一种共存；这种共存若要持久，就必须同时在科学与技术研究部门以及生产与商业化部门中建立起来。（下游如何能缺少上游，或反过来，上游如何能缺少下游？）理论上的答案显而易见：必须让 MA1 广泛获取技术资源，尤其是通过促进它与公共研究在田间实验中的合作；同时必须改造知识产权制度，使之更接近 COV 所开启的那种制度。然后，对称地，必须让 MA2 进入农民的田地，但要以这样一种方式：严格组织并控制不同类型农业之间的地域分布，尤其是通过实施协商装置、（环境与健康）监测与追踪装置，并确保更大范围的地理区隔，从而有利于不同作物类型经合理安排的交错分布。

This kind of political engineering is demanding. It must first imagine the appropriate framings for each of the MAs and then ensure their articulation. This requires numerous inventions. I will not give an inventory, but just mention a few as an illustration: qualculation instruments, which, in order to ensure the continuous integration of the produced data, must be coupled to the devices that measure and monitor potential externalities; the organization of commercial meetings that favor short circuits and lead to an attachment to a natural agriculture dynamic, but that also allow interested farmers to understand the specific qualities of transgenic seeds and to work to showcase their commercial value; price formulations that integrate what certain economists have called “preservation of identity costs,” both farmers’ identities and plants’ identities, formulations that further take into account the costs of prevention, monitoring, and acquiring the knowledge necessary to improve control over contaminations, but also the cost of coordinating the different agents (linked to the way participatory decision devices work), as well as the costs of compensating for losses when contaminations do occur. To all of this, one should add the balanced management of public research activity and cooperation with private agencies.

Altogether, such political engineering, which remains largely to be invented, breaks with the usual models for commercial activity and market functioning. It is the only possible viable strategy if we are to respond to the set of requirements set out in Article 2 of the 2008 law and to make the qualification of goods (which goods, for whom, and at what prices?) one of the key issues for organizing economic activities. The notion of market agencement can nourish this brainstorming, whose goal is to establish compromises between aims that are equally respectable and legitimate. The notion of market agencements can help, first because it considers all the activities, from upstream to downstream, that contribute to establishing commercial transactions and also because it draws attention to the different framings and their materiality.

这类政治工程要求很高。它必须首先为各个 MA 设想适当的诸框定，然后确保它们的接合。这需要大量发明。我不会给出完整清单，只举几项作为例示：质算工具——为确保对所产生数据的持续整合，这些工具必须与测量和监测潜在外部性的装置相耦合；商业相遇的组织——它有利于短链流通，并促成对自然农业动态的附着，但也使感兴趣的农民能够理解转基因种子的特殊品质，并努力展示其商业价值；价格构式——它纳入某些经济学家所称的“身份保全成本”，既包括农民的身份，也包括植物的身份；这些构式还考虑预防、监测以及获取必要知识以改善对污染之控制的成本，也考虑协调不同行动者的成本（与参与式决策装置的运作方式相关），以及在污染确实发生时补偿损失的成本。在这一切之外，还应加上对公共研究活动以及与私人能动者之合作的平衡管理。

总而言之，这种在很大程度上仍待发明的政治工程，与商业活动和市场运作的通常模式决裂。如果我们要回应2008年法律第2条所提出的一整套要求，并使物品的品质界定（何种物品、为谁、以何种价格？）成为组织经济活动的关键议题之一，那么它就是唯一可能可行的策略。市场装配这一概念可以为这种头脑风暴提供养分，而其目标是在同样可敬且正当的各种目的之间建立妥协。市场装配这一概念能够有所帮助，首先是因为它考虑从上游到下游所有有助于确立商业交易的活动，其次是因为它把注意力引向不同的诸框定及其物质性。

It goes without saying that this goal, whose legal status has been noted, is not shared by everyone. There is nothing exceptional about such an absence of consensus regarding the requirements that market agencements policy should fulfill. In this case, there is significant opposition to the idea that coexistence is a good thing. A very influential minority considers that once GMOs are planted, it will be impossible to avoid contaminations and the dissemination of transgenetic crops and thus impossible to stop their progression. Putting it aside for a subsequent book, I will not go into that debate here. Whatever the case, and whatever the conclusion, theoretical work cannot escape the diffi -cult matter of how to establish the durable and viable coexistence of different agencements that are considered to be mutually incompatible. Not only does this work provide a chance to show and to prove that it is possible to impose binding political objectives on market agencements; it opens a radically new perspective. If it focuses on agencements and their framing devices, an adequate and finely calibrated organization of market activities contributes to making commitments and orientations effective in ways that mere regulatory measures never could.

不言而喻，这一目标——其法律地位已被指出——并非人人认同。对于市场装配政策应当满足哪些要求，缺乏共识并不罕见。在这个案例中，对于共存是一件好事的观念，存在相当强烈的反对。一个极具影响力的少数群体认为，一旦转基因生物被种植，就不可能避免污染与转基因作物的传播，因而也不可能阻止其扩散。我将把这一问题留待后续著作，在此不深入讨论。无论如何，也无论结论如何，理论工作都无法回避这一困难问题：如何建立被认为彼此不可兼容的不同装配之间持久而可行的共存。这项工作不仅提供了机会，去展示并证明有可能把具有约束力的政治目标强加于市场装配；它还开启了一种全新的视角。如果着眼于装配及其框定装置，那么对市场活动作出充分而精细校准的组织，便有助于使承诺与取向以单纯的规制措施永远无法做到的方式产生实效。

The only aim of this final chapter was to underline the central role of theorizing work once certain political or moral demands have been formulated. Contrary to what Figure 1 may have suggested, theorizing is neither a unique moment nor a time-bound activity in a sequential process — theorization is at the heart of the dynamics of the arrangements. (See Figure 2.) As we saw in the case of financial markets, it should be driven by the concerns that existing agencements raise. As the analysis of the contributions of market activities to the politics of fighting global warming suggested, theorizing must also help to conceive of framings that provide answers to the questions on the table, taking the existing power relations into account and imagining acceptable compromises among the multitude of concerns and proposals. Finally, theorization must venture to undertake the difficult task of proposing new framings and accept the challenges of implementing these. Even where, in extreme cases, no common solution is to be found, this may require inventing modalities for the coexistence of competing solutions and agencements. Agriculture is a case in point.

这最后一章的唯一目的，是强调一旦某些政治或道德要求被提出，理论化工作便具有核心作用。与图1可能给人的印象相反，理论化既不是仅出现一次的环节，也不是顺序过程中限于特定时段的活动——理论化处于诸安排的动态的核心。（见图2。）正如我们在金融市场的情形中所见，它应当由既有装配所引发的关切来驱动。正如对市场活动在抗击全球变暖的政治中所作贡献的分析所表明的，理论化还必须帮助构想出能够回答摆在桌面上的问题的框定，同时顾及既有的权力关系，并在众多关切与提议之间设想可接受的妥协。最后，理论化必须敢于承担提出新框定这一困难任务，并接受实施这些框定所带来的挑战。即便在极端情形下找不到共同的解决办法，这也可能要求发明各种方式，使相互竞争的解决办法与装配得以共存。农业就是一个恰切的例子。
“The idea of another society has become almost impossible to think and indeed no one today has even the sketch of a new concept. We are condemned to live in the world we live in.”

These are not the words of Margaret Thatcher, who memorably once asserted “There is no alternative!” These are the words of François Furet, the expert on revolutions. If Furet is partly correct, it is because he is talking about society. As Alain Touraine said forty years ago, society doesn’t exist anymore, and so it is pointless to try to change it. But between the first and the second of Furet’s sentences, there is a slippage that surreptitiously ruins his argument while opening up new perspectives. We live in a world of qualculative agencies and goods that constantly change and proliferate, that of agencements, whether they be market, political, or moral. No description can peg that world and reduce it to what we call society.

When we have barely caught a glimpse of it, it has already changed. And the possibility of interfering and acting on the trajectory lies in the multitude of small changes that feed this dynamic, of which I have tried to give a preliminary inventory, limited, granted, to market activities. Other worlds are possible, but they must be composed from elements and resources that lie far beyond those generally associated with the term “social.” The aim of this book, which is reaching its end, is precisely to offer a more complete picture of market activities, one that accounts for their organization and functioning and that provides footholds for orienting their dynamics and development.
“关于另一个社会的观念已变得几乎无法思考；事实上，今天没有人哪怕拥有一个新概念的草图。我们注定要生活在我们所生活的世界之中。”

这些话并非出自玛格丽特·撒切尔（Margaret Thatcher）之口，她曾令人难忘地断言：“别无选择！”这些话出自研究革命的专家弗朗索瓦·孚雷（François Furet）之口。如果说孚雷有部分道理，那是因为他谈论的是社会。正如阿兰·图雷纳（Alain Touraine）四十年前所说，社会已不复存在，因此试图改变它是没有意义的。但在孚雷的第一句与第二句话之间，存在一处滑移：它暗中摧毁了他的论证，同时又开启了新的视角。我们生活在一个由不断变化、不断增殖的质算的能动者与物品构成的世界，即装配的世界，无论这些装配是市场的、政治的，还是道德的。没有任何描述能够钉住那个世界，把它化约为我们所谓的社会。

我们才刚刚瞥见它，它就已经改变了。而干预并作用于这一轨迹的可能性，就在于众多滋养这一动态的微小变化之中；我曾试图为这些变化提供一份初步清单——诚然，这份清单仅限于市场活动。其他世界是可能的，但它们必须由一些要素与资源来构成，而这些要素与资源远远超出通常与“社会的”一词相关联的范围。本书即将收尾，其目的恰恰在于提供一幅关于市场活动的更完整图景：这幅图景说明市场活动的组织与运作，并为引导其动态与发展提供立足点。
